description: Directional pushing tasks for C3 greedy-contact-mode testing. Task ID selects goal direction; all other task parameters are inherited from tasks.yaml -> pushing. 2026-07-28 frame migration: goals re-centered on the reference box init (0.5, 0) — the old origin-centered goals predated ed16080's arm-base-at-origin move (box then spawned inside panda_link0). Offsets are 0.15 m so every goal stays inside the reference workspace annulus 0.25 <= r <= 0.75 (robot_radius_limits; +-0.3 offsets would put east at r=0.8 and west at r=0.2).

1.name: north
1.description: Push box 15cm north. Testing whether C3 can push orthogonally to the initial approach direction.

2.name: east
2.description: Push box 15cm east (away from the arm). Contact normal aligned with goal direction. Baseline case.

3.name: south
3.description: Push box 15cm south. Orthogonal goal (opposite north).

4.name: west
4.description: Push box 15cm west (toward the arm). Contact normal anti-aligned with goal direction. Requires a contact mode switch.
